exposure: Compliance with an in-use checklist for oxytocin monitoring
fetal monitoring-related practices during induced labor
Category II fetal heart rate tracings
specified category II fetal heart rate tracings
decrease in the infusion rate of oxytocin
outcome: Apgar score less than 7 at 1 and 5 minutes
cohort: 14,398 women undergoing oxytocin induction of labor
finding: Decreasing the oxytocin infusion rate in response to specific category II fetal heart rate tracings and using a checklist for oxytocin monitoring were both associated with improved neonatal outcomes and a lower cesarean delivery rate.
mod_finding: The study found that utilization of a checklist for oxytocin monitoring during induced labor was associated with a reduction in the cesarean delivery rate.
